messages:
Alex R.: Quick request — we need to scale up GPU capacity for an expected inference spike next month. Options I'm proposing (ap-southeast1 primary):
1) 12x H100 reserved 1yr commit (~$160k/mo equivalent)
2) 8x H100 reserved + 4x spot fallback (~$120k/mo effective) 
3) 24x A100 mixed pool with autoscale (~$140k/mo)
Can FinOps weigh in by EOD Thu? Prefer option 2 for cost/latency balance.

Tammy (FinOps): Can you post the breakout for those numbers and the assumptions (utilization %, preemption rate, egress)? APAC list prices are higher so region matters. Also include whether Dedicated capacity can be repurposed.

Alex R.: Sure — assumptions: 75% average utilization for reserved nodes, spots cover burst to 95% for ~3h/day, expected 18M tokens/day. Preemption estimate for ap-southeast1 spots: 22%. Egress ~6TB/day. Quick calc: option2 = $118,900/mo; option1 = $159,700/mo; option3 = $139,200/mo.

Maria S.: 22% preemption aligns with last month's numbers in ap-southeast1. If we go spot fallback, we need fast warmup caching and graceful fallback to a smaller model to avoid errors.

Jonah P.: Could we slice Dedicated dev capacity for 4 weeks to cover the spike instead of buying new commit? That would need approvals from product teams but could save ~30% short-term.

Sophia L.: Heads-up on networking: if burst hits 8k rps we might run into NIC saturation on some hosts in ap-southeast1. SRE needs to validate egress quotas and L4 limits.

Tammy (FinOps): Uploaded a spreadsheet with line-item math: https://redwood-internal.sheets/gpu-q2-sourcing (permissions: infra+finops). Key rows: reserved unit price, spot hourly, preemption loss multiplier, egress surcharge. Also flagged budget variance: projected Q2 GPU spend +41% vs forecast if we default to on-demand.

Alex R.: Paste of critical rows:
```
Option, ReservedCount, SpotCount, EstMonthlyCost
Opt1,12,0,159700
Opt2,8,4,118900
Opt3,0,24,139200
```

Infra Bot: :warning: Billing anomaly detected — projected monthly GPU spend (ap-southeast1) exceeds budget threshold for team inference by 34%. See /billing alerts.

Tammy (FinOps): My conditional recommendation: approve Option 2 (8 reserved + 4 spot) if infra agrees to: 1) enable canary rollout and autoscale caps, 2) instrument token-level cost telemetry, 3) use quantized model profile q8_0 for CPU/GPU mix to shave token compute. Also require a rollback plan to fallback to A100 pool if preemption >40% for 48h.

Jonah P.: I can patch the autoscale and canary configs. Will add preemption monitor and an automatic model-fallback lambda.

Sophia L.: SRE will run a quick network cap check and add egress throttles if needed. If network looks good I'll +1 Tammy's conditions.

Maria S.: I'll run a short stress test against spot nodes tomorrow morning to validate preemption handling.

Alex R.: Thanks — will circle back with procurement wording. Requesting approval flag from Tammy when you're ready so I can start the purchase flow.

Tammy (FinOps): Approve Option 2 with the conditions above. Please attach the canary playbook and the cost telemetry dashboard before procurement. :thumbsup:

Alex R.: Got it — adding playbook and dashboard link to the PR. Will tag the deploy bots when ready.

Deploy Bot: deploy-status — staged canary config created for inference-pool; awaiting manual start.

Infra Bot: note — ETA for new reservation availability: 6-8 business days after purchase in ap-southeast1.

Alex R.: Thanks all — filing the purchase request now.
